{
  "sop_id": "SOP-018",
  "title": "Daily Operations Report",
  "steps": [
    {"step_id": "S1", "name": "Create ticket and assign to self", "role": "Executor", "type": "intake"},
    {"step_id": "S2", "name": "Collect production, downtime and manpower data", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S3", "name": "Reconcile against plan and compute KPIs", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S4", "name": "Record incidents, deviations and actions taken", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S5", "name": "Compile and publish report", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "A1", "name": "Incharge review and approval", "role": "Incharge", "type": "approval"},
    {"step_id": "R1", "name": "Correct and republish on rejection", "role": "Executor", "type": "rework"}
  ],
  "approvals": [
    {"stage": "Incharge", "condition": "KPI breach or safety event flagged"},
    {"stage": "Lead", "condition": "Always"}
  ],
  "dependencies": [],
  "rework_reasons": [
    "Wrong quantity",
    "Amount mismatch",
    "Incorrect category",
    "Required document missing"
  ],
  "first_pass_yield_target": 0.95
}
